UK TIMES investment cost, transcribed by Bataille from the UKTM model: 3.535 GBP million per Mt_a in 2010 prices. The millions cancel the mega- in the capacity unit exactly, so the value is unchanged.

COST BASIS: incremental. CAPACITY BASIS: thermal-output. Cost is PER kWh OF STORAGE CAPACITY (stored energy), not per kW of thermal power - the capacity-basis vocabulary has no energy-capacity basis, so thermal-output is the nearest; do not pool with EUR/kW figures. A thermal store is an add-on to a heat supply system (design.md 'Add-ons and components'); the brief gives no base-system cost, so this cannot form a whole-plant cost from this source. CURRENCY YEAR NOT STATED anywhere in the brief for EUR figures; 2013_EUR is the publication year (January 2013), a flagged judgement. The underlying source [1]/[12] is Hauer, 2010-2011. Table 1 prints 10-50; p.2 and p.6 [12] agree ('between EUR 10 and EUR 50 per kWh'). p.6: systems with micro-encapsulated PCM can cost more; 'the difference between the pure PCM and the complete TES system is even higher for active PCM installations'. The Table 8 summary prints this cell as 'ott-50' - a spreadsheet date conversion of '10-50' (Italian 'ott' = October) - which is one reason the summary is not used. Table 1 is generic across buildings, district heating and industry; the brief does not split industrial values out.
